q: The Toda lattice is a completely integrable Hamiltonian system of n particles with exponential nearest-neighbor interactions. Its integrability is established via a Lax pair (L, B) satisfying:
exp: Lax pair: L̇ = [L,B] implies that eigenvalues of L are conserved quantities (since d/dt eig(L) = 0 follows from L̇ = [L,B]). This generates enough integrals of motion for complete integrability. The Toda lattice was the first non-trivial system shown completely integrable via the Lax method.
